temporal_state_chain.observed: Patricia looks more withdrawn than usual during their shifts; when Jose asks, she says it is nothing really, just some personal stuff, and thanks him for asking.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia is usually vibrant at work, and Jose has no specific reason to think something is wrong.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — he moves from no specific concern to suspecting Patricia is troubled by an undisclosed personal matter.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia is dealing with some personal issue, but she is not ready to share details; she appreciates Jose's offer to listen.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Offer support and a listening ear without pressing her for details.

temporal_state_chain.observed: During lunch, Jose overhears Patricia on the phone worrying about bills and financial commitments.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia has an undisclosed personal issue and may be withdrawn; she appreciated his earlier offer to listen.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — he gains a specific reason for concern: Patricia is stressed about finances.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia is overwhelmed by bills and financial commitments; budgeting or financial planning help might be useful to her.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concern, empathy, and a desire to help.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Offer to discuss financial planning or budgeting with her and help when she feels ready.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jose asks whether Patricia minded his earlier financial-planning offer; she says she did not think he was prying and is grateful for his help.

temporal_state_chain.intention: Continue being supportive while respecting her boundaries.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Patricia responds to his check-in politely but generally: everything is good, she plans a quiet weekend, and she thanks him for being available without sharing more.

temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — he senses that she values his concern but prefers to handle her issues privately.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia appreciates Jose's concern but wants privacy and independence; she will ask for help if she needs it.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Maintain a supportive presence without pushing; check in casually and give her space.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Patricia says she is busy but handling things, thanks him for checking in, and says it is great to have his support; Jose reiterates he is available to help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia appreciates his concern but prefers to manage her issues privately and will reach out if needed.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: No major change — her response confirms she is managing and values his light-touch support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia is handling her situation, values his support, and will ask if she needs help; Jose should remain available without overstepping.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Continue regular supportive check-ins and offer help without pressure.
